thread:
sam_sre: Heads up — after the RBAC sweep at 11:10 UTC we're seeing a spike in mTLS handshake failures for svc->svc calls in ap-south and eu-west. Logs show KMS Unwrap/Decrypt denied when cert rotator fetches ephemeral private keys.

mike_security: paste sample error pls.

sam_sre: proxy log (trim): `handshake failed: tls: failed to configure private key: kms:DecryptAccessDenied: access denied for key projects/prod/keys/ephemeral-rotator; principal serviceAccount:rotator@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com missing roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`

priya_platform: that RBAC PR (3421) tightened infra scopes — rotator may have lost decrypt.

jen_oncall: impact: spike in 5xx for async routing; some canary traffic fell back. Handshake failures correlate with rotator job schedule.

sam_sre: mitigation options: rollback RBAC for rotator SA or configure rotator to use fallback key in another KMS project. Which is faster?

mike_security: rollback is fastest but capture audit before change. Grab IAM diff and CloudAudit/KMS logs. Also check for delegated principals or revoked tokens.

priya_platform: I'll revert PR 3421 if we confirm SA. We'll add a temporary exception and follow up to scope properly.

sam_sre: also saw `client session ticket decrypt failed: key not found` — probably resumption keys missing.

mike_security: query suggestion: `protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com" AND protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt" AND jsonPayload.status.code=7 AND resource.labels.project_id="prod"`

jen_oncall: found ~120 Deny events 11:09-11:18 UTC from rotator SA in ap-south1 and a few from eu-west1 staging.

priya_platform: rolling back now — reverting PR 3421 and creating emergency exception: iam:roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter -> rotator@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com, TTL 1h.

deploy-bot: revert PR 3421 merged by priya_platform at 2026-03-23T11:20:05Z :white_check_mark: 

sam_sre: handshake failure rate fell ~2min after revert. Can we add proxy circuit-breaker to avoid failing closed when rotator unwraps fail? Use cached key for short window.

mike_security: agree — short-term policy: if unwrap fails, allow cached key for 10s. Need config change and security review note. Also export audit logs to incident folder and validate no lateral privilege escalation during rollback.

priya_platform: post-incident tasks: repro in staging with RBAC tighten, create least-privileged KMS role with IAM Condition (sa + key), add proxy circuit-breaker & unwrap observability, update runbook to check KMS unwraps early.

jen_oncall: alerts: KMS DecryptAccessDenied >5 in 5m -> page; handshake-failure rate >1% in 5m -> page.

sam_sre: ensure IAM bindings consistent across projects/regions so cross-region rotator calls don't fail during rollouts.

mike_security: will diff bindings and ensure rotation plan updates bindings before privilege removal. Collecting logs now for incident page.

priya_platform: emergency window closes in 1h unless we see further denys. I'll post audit export to #postmortems and tag people.

sam_sre: thanks — please paste audit export link and tag me. :thumbsup:
